This role focuses on identifying and reaching potential prospects, building prospect lists, and using Salesforce and other software tools to support outreach efforts. The ideal candidate has previous sales experience, strong communication skills, and the ability to build rapport with prospects quickly. Identify and engage potential prospects to support the company's business development efforts. Use Salesforce and other software tools to find contact information, build prospect lists, and organize outreach activities. Communicate the company's services clearly to generate interest and encourage prospects to attend scheduled appointments. Maintain organized prospect information and use available software tools to support outreach efforts.
